quality_benchmark: A Day at the Beach (~9/10 visual/product/pedagogy)

units.title: Hello, Friends!
units.communicative_goal: Greet, introduce yourself, ask and say names, say goodbye.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can greet a peer, say their name, ask a peer's name, and say goodbye.

lessons.target_language: Hello! / Hi! / Goodbye! / Bye!
lessons.objective: Greet and leave politely in a classroom welcome scene.

lessons.target_language: My name is ___. / I'm ___.
lessons.objective: Introduce yourself with a clear name sentence.

lessons.target_language: What's your name? — My name is ___.
lessons.objective: Ask and answer name questions with a partner.

lessons.target_language: Nice to meet you. / Nice to meet you, too.
lessons.objective: Use meeting language in a short friend-introduction story.

lessons.target_language: Hello, I'm ___. What's your name? Nice to meet you. Goodbye!
lessons.objective: Integrate greeting + name + goodbye in a class party mission.

units.title: All About Me
units.communicative_goal: Say age, feelings, likes; present a simple 'about me' card.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can say name, age, a feeling, and one like.

lessons.target_language: I am ___ years old. / How old are you?
lessons.objective: Ask and say ages with birthday-cake visuals.

lessons.target_language: How are you? — I'm happy/sad/tired.
lessons.objective: Express basic feelings with face cards and buddy check.

lessons.target_language: I like ___. / I don't like ___.
lessons.objective: State likes and dislikes with picture choice.

lessons.target_language: I'm ___. I'm ___ years old. I'm ___. I like ___.
lessons.objective: Build a personal 'about me' card with recycled language.

lessons.target_language: Hi, I'm ___. I'm ___ years old. I like ___.
lessons.objective: Present the about-me card to a partner / class.

units.title: My Family
units.communicative_goal: Name family members and say who people are.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can introduce family members with This is my ___.

lessons.target_language: This is my mom/dad.
lessons.objective: Identify and introduce parents.

lessons.target_language: This is my brother/sister.
lessons.objective: Talk about siblings with photo-match play.

lessons.target_language: This is my grandma/grandpa.
lessons.objective: Introduce grandparents in a weekend-visit scene.

lessons.target_language: Who is this? — This is my ___.
lessons.objective: Ask and answer identity questions about family photos.

lessons.target_language: This is my ___. I love my family.
lessons.objective: Build and present a simple family tree board.

units.title: Pet Pals
units.communicative_goal: Name common pets and say what they are / what you have.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name pets and say I have a ___ / It's a ___.

lessons.target_language: It's a dog/cat/fish…
lessons.objective: Identify five pets in a pet-shop discovery walk.

lessons.target_language: I have a ___. / I don't have a ___.
lessons.objective: Say ownership of pets with yes/no sorting.

lessons.target_language: I feed my ___. / Let's walk the dog.
lessons.objective: Use simple action phrases for pet care.

lessons.target_language: Where is my ___? / Look! It's here!
lessons.objective: Search-and-find story recycling pet names.

lessons.target_language: This is my ___. I like my ___.
lessons.objective: Present a favorite pet in a mini pet-show.

units.title: School Day
units.communicative_goal: Name school things and say what you have / need.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name school items and say I have/need a ___.

lessons.target_language: What's this? — It's a ___.
lessons.objective: Unpack a school bag and name items.

lessons.target_language: I have a ___. / I need a ___.
lessons.objective: Contrast have vs need while packing for class.

lessons.target_language: Where is the ___? — It's here.
lessons.objective: Locate classroom objects with route/search play.

lessons.target_language: Can I have a ___? — Here you are. Thank you.
lessons.objective: Practice classroom politeness exchanges.

lessons.target_language: I have a ___. I'm ready!
lessons.objective: Pack a complete bag and announce readiness.

units.title: Colors & Clothes
units.communicative_goal: Name colors and clothes; say what someone is wearing.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can describe clothes with color + item.

lessons.target_language: It's red/blue… / What color is it?
lessons.objective: Name core colors with paint-and-sort play.

lessons.target_language: It's a shirt/hat…
lessons.objective: Identify clothing items in a closet scene.

lessons.target_language: I have a red shirt. / It's a blue hat.
lessons.objective: Combine color + noun for clothing.

lessons.target_language: I'm wearing a ___ ___ .
lessons.objective: Describe today's outfit.

lessons.target_language: She's wearing a ___ ___. / He's wearing…
lessons.objective: Comment on outfits in a kid fashion-show payoff.

units.title: Yummy Food
units.communicative_goal: Name foods and express like/want for snacks and meals.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can order/request simple food with I want / I like.

lessons.target_language: It's an apple. / I like bananas.
lessons.objective: Name fruits and state likes.

lessons.target_language: I want a ___. / I'm hungry.
lessons.objective: Request snacks with want + hunger phrase.

lessons.target_language: I want water/milk/juice, please.
lessons.objective: Choose and request drinks politely.

lessons.target_language: Put the ___ in the basket. / We need ___.
lessons.objective: Pack a picnic recycling food vocabulary.

lessons.target_language: I want a ___ and ___ , please.
lessons.objective: Place a two-item order at a kid food truck.

units.title: My Home
units.communicative_goal: Name rooms and furniture; say where things are.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name rooms and locate objects in the home.

lessons.target_language: This is the kitchen/bedroom…
lessons.objective: Tour rooms of a house.

lessons.target_language: It's a table/bed…
lessons.objective: Name furniture items.

lessons.target_language: The book is on the table. / It's under the bed.
lessons.objective: Use basic prepositions of place at home.

lessons.target_language: Put the ___ on/in the ___.
lessons.objective: Repair a messy bedroom with place language.

lessons.target_language: This is my ___. The ___ is in the ___.
lessons.objective: Give a short home tour presentation.

units.title: Daily Routines
units.communicative_goal: Talk about simple daily actions with present simple.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can sequence a simple daily routine.

lessons.target_language: I wake up. / I eat breakfast.
lessons.objective: Describe morning actions in order.

lessons.target_language: I go to school. / I play.
lessons.objective: Talk about daytime activities.

lessons.target_language: I eat dinner. / I go to bed.
lessons.objective: Describe evening routine.

lessons.target_language: First I ___. Then I ___.
lessons.objective: Sequence routine steps with connectors.

lessons.target_language: Every day I ___, then I ___.
lessons.objective: Build and retell a personal day comic.

units.title: Town & Places
units.communicative_goal: Name town places and say where you go / want to go.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name places and propose going somewhere.

lessons.target_language: This is the park/shop…
lessons.objective: Label places on a town map.

lessons.target_language: Where's the ___? — It's next to the ___.
lessons.objective: Ask for places with simple location phrases.

lessons.target_language: Let's go to the ___!
lessons.objective: Suggest destinations with friends.

lessons.target_language: I need to go to the ___.
lessons.objective: Complete a multi-stop errand route.

lessons.target_language: My favorite place is the ___. Let's go!
lessons.objective: Present a favorite town place.

units.title: Sports & Play
units.communicative_goal: Name sports/games and say what you can / like to play.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can say sports they play and simple abilities.

lessons.target_language: I play soccer/basketball…
lessons.objective: Name sports and match to equipment.

lessons.target_language: I can run/jump. / I can't ___ yet.
lessons.objective: Talk about basic physical abilities.

lessons.target_language: Let's play on the ___! / Throw the ball!
lessons.objective: Use playground action language.

lessons.target_language: We can ___! / Help me, please!
lessons.objective: Cooperate in a simple sports mission.

lessons.target_language: My favorite sport is ___. I can ___.
lessons.objective: Present a favorite sport and one ability.

units.title: Music Makers
units.communicative_goal: Name instruments and talk about music preferences and making music.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name instruments and say I play / I like music.

lessons.target_language: It's a piano/guitar…
lessons.objective: Identify instruments in a band room.

lessons.target_language: I play the ___. / I sing. / I dance.
lessons.objective: Talk about music actions.

lessons.target_language: Play loud/soft. / It's fast/slow.
lessons.objective: Describe music with simple adjectives.

lessons.target_language: Let's play together! / Start! Stop!
lessons.objective: Coordinate a pretend band rehearsal.

lessons.target_language: I like this song. I can sing/dance!
lessons.objective: Create a simple music-video performance payoff.

units.title: Weather Wear
units.communicative_goal: Describe weather and choose appropriate clothes.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can say today's weather and choose gear.

lessons.target_language: It's sunny/rainy today.
lessons.objective: Identify weather types.

lessons.target_language: It's hot/cold. / I'm hot/cold.
lessons.objective: Talk about temperature feelings.

lessons.target_language: It's rainy — take an umbrella. / Wear a coat.
lessons.objective: Match clothes/gear to weather.

lessons.target_language: Today it's ___. Tomorrow it's ___.
lessons.objective: Read a simple two-day forecast board.

lessons.target_language: It's ___. I need a ___. I'm ready!
lessons.objective: Pack weather gear and announce readiness.

units.title: Shopping Fun
units.communicative_goal: Shop with simple prices, wants, and polite requests.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can buy something with How much? and Can I have…?

lessons.target_language: I want to buy a ___.
lessons.objective: Enter a shop and state a purchase want.

lessons.target_language: How much is it? — It's ___ dollars.
lessons.objective: Ask and say simple prices.

lessons.target_language: Can I have a ___, please? — Here you are.
lessons.objective: Practice shop request dialogues.

lessons.target_language: I need ___. Put it in the cart.
lessons.objective: Complete a shopping list scavenger hunt.

lessons.target_language: How much? … Here you are. Thank you. Goodbye!
lessons.objective: Run a full mini checkout roleplay.

units.title: Transport & Go!
units.communicative_goal: Name transport and say how you go places.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can say how they travel to places.

lessons.target_language: It's a bus/train…
lessons.objective: Identify transport vehicles.

lessons.target_language: I go to school by bus. / I go by bike.
lessons.objective: Say travel methods to destinations.

lessons.target_language: Get on the bus! / Get off here!
lessons.objective: Use boarding language on a pretend bus.

lessons.target_language: Where is my ticket? / Help me, please!
lessons.objective: Solve a transport problem story.

lessons.target_language: I go to the ___ by ___.
lessons.objective: Plan and present a simple trip.

units.title: Animals at the Zoo
units.communicative_goal: Name zoo animals and describe simple actions/abilities.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name zoo animals and say It can ___ / It is ___.

lessons.target_language: It's a lion/elephant…
lessons.objective: Meet zoo animals at the gate.

lessons.target_language: The elephant is big. / The penguin is small.
lessons.objective: Describe animals with adjectives.

lessons.target_language: It can swim/fly/climb.
lessons.objective: Match animals to abilities.

lessons.target_language: The ___ is hungry. Feed the ___!
lessons.objective: Complete a feeding-time mission.

lessons.target_language: My favorite animal is the ___. It can ___.
lessons.objective: Present a favorite zoo animal.

units.title: Camping Outdoors
units.communicative_goal: Talk about camping gear, nature, and outdoor actions.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can pack camping gear and give simple outdoor instructions.

lessons.target_language: I need a tent/flashlight…
lessons.objective: Pack camping equipment.

lessons.target_language: Look! A ___! / Let's walk to the river.
lessons.objective: Name nature items on a trail.

lessons.target_language: Set up the tent. / Light the fire.
lessons.objective: Follow camping setup instructions.

lessons.target_language: What's that? / It's OK. We're safe.
lessons.objective: Solve a gentle night-sounds mystery.

lessons.target_language: I like camping. First we ___, then we ___.
lessons.objective: Retell the camping day sequence.

units.title: Hobbies & Makers
units.communicative_goal: Talk about hobbies, crafts, and making things.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can say hobbies and present something they made.

lessons.target_language: I like to draw/read…
lessons.objective: Name common kid hobbies.

lessons.target_language: I need glue/paper. / Let's make a ___.
lessons.objective: Request craft materials.

lessons.target_language: Cut the ___. Stick it on. Build it!
lessons.objective: Follow a make-and-build sequence.

lessons.target_language: Smile! Action! / Look at my video!
lessons.objective: Roleplay making a short kid video.

lessons.target_language: I made a ___. I like it!
lessons.objective: Present a finished craft/creation.

units.title: Adventure Park
units.communicative_goal: Navigate rides, tickets, feelings, and choices at a park.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can choose rides and express excitement/fear politely.

lessons.target_language: This is the ___ ride. / Let's buy tickets.
lessons.objective: Orient to park places and tickets.

lessons.target_language: Which ride? — I want the ___!
lessons.objective: Choose rides with preference language.

lessons.target_language: I'm excited! / I'm a little scared.
lessons.objective: Express feelings before rides.

lessons.target_language: Where is my friend? / Let's meet at the gate.
lessons.objective: Solve a gentle lost-buddy problem.

lessons.target_language: My favorite ride is the ___. What a fun day!
lessons.objective: Review the park day with a photo-board payoff.

units.title: Helpers & Jobs
units.communicative_goal: Name community helpers and say what they do.
units.unit_end_capability: Learner can name jobs and say who helps in a situation.

lessons.target_language: He/She is a doctor/teacher…
lessons.objective: Identify community helpers.

lessons.target_language: A teacher teaches. / A chef cooks.
lessons.objective: Match jobs to simple actions.

lessons.target_language: I need help! / Please help me.
lessons.objective: Use help language in problem scenes.

lessons.target_language: Who can help? — The firefighter can help!
lessons.objective: Choose the right helper for scenarios.

lessons.target_language: I want to be a ___. I can help!
lessons.objective: Share a future helper identity.
